new_results.moving_gap_corridor: For Q_m=floor((log m-4 log log m-log 129)/log 62208), every prime 6m<p<=6m+Q_m is excluded once Q_m>=1.
new_results.method_class_no_go: Any nonzero fixed-gap carrier bounded by A*q^C*B^q and used only through p>A*q^C*B^q can control only O((log m)^2)=o(m) logarithmic mass at row m.
new_results.primitive_cubic_radical_carrier: For q congruent to 5 mod 6, common actual first-digit support is exactly p|gcd(W0(q),W1(q)); rho is redundant. For q congruent to 1 mod 6, rho is necessary to enforce a common cube-root branch.
new_results.carrier_minimality: Exact witnesses show that rho alone, one cubic row alone, and two cubic rows in the nonbijective class are each insufficient.

remaining_open: uniform failure of the final power-of-two compatibility at divisors of the connection determinant

scope_warning: The corridor is an exclusion theorem and the method-class result is a scoped no-go. Neither supplies a positive divisor rate or a numerical Route-1 ledger improvement.
